coverageAccounting.interpretation: Distinct inventories, not 12/12 mutant coverage or closed-library certification.

controls.name: same-name-arity-erased-body-substitution
controls.recipe: Keep canonical typed List identity and matching fact name/arity; replace only erased body with another affine supported body.
controls.structuralEntryExpectation: May accept: this helper checks role/layout and name/arity, not erasure derivation.
controls.trustedBoundaryExpectation: Reject substituted capture hash or obtain fact only through ns_body of internally created checked request.

controls.name: forged-declared-arity-function-result
controls.recipe: Change source declared arity for p110_cert_function_result from1 to2, and provide matching erased arity2.
controls.structuralEntryExpectation: Can reinterpret function-valued result as another canonical parameter; original metadata authenticity is mandatory.
controls.trustedBoundaryExpectation: Reject mutation of original checked source product; do not accept host-repaired arity.

controls.name: same-path-Base-byte-change
controls.recipe: Read modified Base bytes at the same configured path, or provide expected text derived from that same untrusted read.
controls.trustedBoundaryExpectation: Reject before p86_prepare against independently compiled exact Base text/path.
controls.status: new live factory planned by IR agent; current fixed-contract frontend delegates asset authentication to launcher

controls.name: seed-source-book-world-mismatch
controls.recipe: Keep P86Seed.source equal to trusted Base FSource while changing book/ready/world.
controls.structuralEntryExpectation: f_seed_matches alone inspects source fields only.
controls.trustedBoundaryExpectation: Do not expose raw seed ingestion; construct all seed components internally through authenticated p86_prepare or authenticated cache factory.
controls.status: new internal live factory planned by IR agent

controls.name: canonical-root-unsupported-private-callee
controls.recipe: Use closure-source p110_close_unsupported_callee or p110_close_generic root.
controls.trustedBoundaryExpectation: Reject private Char or erased generic dependency even though exported root telescope certifies.
controls.status: frozen source-only; entry checker does not currently evaluate closedLibraryAccepted

controls.name: missing-or-duplicate-private-fact
controls.recipe: Remove or duplicate p110_close_mid/leaf fact under its original source identity.
controls.trustedBoundaryExpectation: Reject complete library; never silently omit/refill dependency from another request.

controls.name: capture-status-inconsistency
controls.recipe: Keep checked=true and exitCode=0 but change capture kind/status/typeAccepted or omit authenticated native-facts/typed products.
controls.trustedBoundaryExpectation: Reject inconsistent capture metadata and any unauthenticated product before calling structural APIs.
controls.status: current check.mjs checks complete/checked/exitCode/products but not kind/status/typeAccepted explicitly

boundaryLimits: nxe_entry and nxe_planned are raw internal helpers, not standalone provenance authority.
Exact Base byte binding supplies U32/Word/native scalar representation provenance beyond the three explicitly walked descriptors.
Current native fixed six-source contracts are separate from unintegrated admission prototype; no claim that generic fixed-contract workers passed canonical nxe gate.
ABI agent independently owns reserved-local namespace hardening.
